standard_prerequisites.name: The extension of a coherent module on the complement of a closed subset to a coherent module on the ambient scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 1749-1751) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the finite module whose local cohomology controls the higher direct images.

standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of the local cohomology of a finite module with the cohomology of the complement, including the exact sequence and the degree shifts
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1758-1766) as pointers to a lemma of this chapter and two sections of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the question about higher direct images into a question about local cohomology of the extended module.

core_obligations: Extend the module: by the extension statement there is a coherent module on the affine scheme whose restriction to the complement is the given module, corresponding to a finite module, which proves the first assertion (proof lines 1749-1753)
Describe the direct images: the higher direct images are quasi-coherent and correspond to the cohomology of the complement, so the local cohomology description applies (proof lines 1754-1757)

Deduce the exact sequence: the comparison between the cohomology of the complement and the local cohomology gives the displayed exact sequence and the degree shifts, using that the higher cohomology of a quasi-coherent sheaf on the affine scheme vanishes (proof lines 1758-1770)
Transfer finiteness: the equivalence of the three finiteness conditions and the final normalisation of the module follow formally from the exact sequence and the degree shifts (proof lines 1771-1772)
proof_roadmap: 把 U 上的凝聚层延拓为 X 上的凝聚层（跨章引理），对应有限 A-模 M，即得 (1)；又 R^p j_*F 拟凝聚且对应 H^p(U,F)（跨章引理）。
由本地上同调与补集上同调的比较（本章引理 + 跨章两节）得正合列 0 → H^0_Z(M) → M → H^0(U,F) → H^1_Z(M) → 0 及 H^p(U,F) = H^{p+1}_Z(M)（p ≥ 1），其中用到 X 仿射故 H^j(X,F') = 0 (j > 0)；(3)(4) 由 (2) 形式推出。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects, for a coherent module on the complement of the closed subset defined by an ideal in a Noetherian affine scheme, the existence of a finite module extending it, the exact sequence relating the cohomology of the complement to the local cohomology of that module, the equivalence of three finiteness conditions, and a normalisation of the extending module when degree zero is finite (author lemma at source lines 1723-1746, label lemma-finiteness-pushforwards-and-H1-local). The proof (source lines 1748-1773) extends the module, uses that the higher direct images are quasi-coherent and correspond to the cohomology of the complement, and obtains the exact sequence and the degree shifts from the comparison with local cohomology together with the vanishing of the higher cohomology on the affine scheme (proof lines 1758-1770); the finiteness statements are then read off. The extension step and the translation of the cohomology of the complement into local cohomology are the content. H2.
